boundary: A face number is a categorical teaching handle, not a Noetic operator number, not a magnitude, and not a model input when the role is the thing being recognized.

faces.objective: recognize and select a definition or function consistent with the supplied facts
faces.public_request: state what the whole is and what it is for, as declared
faces.title: Technical name, definition and function

faces.objective: recognize and select a contextual account consistent with the supplied facts
faces.public_request: state the setting and the interactions that hold here
faces.title: Context, environment and interactions

faces.objective: recognize a bounded cross-domain comparison and select the analogy that preserves the specified relationship
faces.public_request: choose the example whose declared relationships match
faces.title: Analogy or metaphor within a declared scope

faces.objective: recognize and select the role and relationship mapping between two presentations
faces.public_request: choose the mapping that preserves the declared relations
faces.title: Explicit correspondence

faces.objective: recognize decomposition and correctly identify constituents and their connections
faces.public_request: list the parts directly inside the requested whole
faces.title: Parts and structural relationships

faces.objective: recognize and select a valid account of how supplied parts or steps form a whole, within the declared process semantics
faces.public_request: choose the complete account of how these parts make the whole
faces.title: Recomposition, story or bounded process
